hostname at-x530-01

service password-encryption
!
no service telnet
service ssh
!
vlan database
 vlan 10 name USERS
 vlan 20 name SERVERS
 vlan 100 name GUEST
!
access-list 3001 permit tcp 10.0.10.0/24 any eq 443
access-list 3001 deny ip any any log
access-list hardware GUEST-IN
 10 permit udp any any eq 53
 20 deny ip any any log
!
interface port1.0.1
 description to-core-01
 switchport
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 10,20
 switchport trunk native vlan 1
 static-channel-group 1
!
interface port1.0.10
 description server-01
 switchport
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 20
 spanning-tree portfast
!
interface port1.0.24
 description guest-ap
 switchport
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 100
 access-group 3001
 access-group GUEST-IN
 shutdown
!
interface vlan10
 ip address 10.0.10.1/24
 ip ospf 1 area 0.0.0.0
!
interface vlan20
 ip address 10.0.20.1/24
!
ip route 0.0.0.0/0 10.0.10.254
ip route 10.9.0.0/16 10.0.20.254 200
!
router ospf 1
 ospf router-id 10.0.10.1
 network 10.0.10.0/24 area 0.0.0.0
!
line vty 0 4
 exec-timeout 10 0
!
end
!
